Hello how does your miners work

Simply put, a Bitcoin miner is a small computer built to do one job. It makes trillions of guesses a second trying to solve the next Bitcoin block.

You plug it into power, connect it to your Wi-Fi, and point it at a mining pool. In a pool you earn a small, steady share of sats. If you mine solo, it's a lottery ticket that runs all day, and if your miner finds a block you get the whole reward.
